decisive_items: mucinous cystadenocarcinoma or sarcoma of the liver
a well-defined, low-density, heterogeneous, multilocular cystic tumor
response.rationale: R1 is supported by both the explicit diagnostic phrase and the detailed imaging description of a multilocular cystic tumor with solid components, which is more characteristic of mucinous cystadenocarcinoma than sarcoma. R4 shares the same diagnostic phrase but lacks the descriptive imaging support, making it a plausible but less substantiated alternative. R2 is unlikely because IPMN typically arises in the pancreas and the imaging shows a large hepatic cystic mass without pancreatic involvement. C1 is a redundant completion of R1 and adds no new raw evidence.

rejected.why: Redundant append-only completion of R1; adds no new raw support beyond the same diagnostic phrase.
IPMN is not supported by the hepatic location and imaging features; DUPAN-2 elevation is nonspecific and the tumor is not pancreatic.
